pages.text: Bog Poles are the young of the Bog Toad. They live in the swamp's shallows and swim in small schools of one or two. A pole never fights; when something threatens it, the pole bolts for deep water, and if it is stranded on land it runs for the nearest pool.
Harmless, and gone the moment you reach for it.

pages.title: Growing Up
pages.text: Left alone, a pole stays a pole for about an hour before it becomes a full Bog Toad. Feeding it cod, salmon or tropical fish speeds this along.$(br2)If adult toads already crowd the area, the pole waits and tries again a minute later. A swamp only ever fills so far.
